question: In a certain coded language 'ROOT' is coded as 'MIJN' and 'FANS' is coded as 'AUIM'. How will 'JAMS' be coded in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

ROOT is coded as MIJN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0840ef57d0b30d2b508ea603708f586b16cfcbfa0b66b2d873742234d3d2e921.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1f8d615fa631dd6b97655c8cb0140a5401f6e3c67993e8b04c9badab6e4c1c1.png] 

FANS is coded as AUIM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a9b64bdd87b1a43d316563a6ed82a2dac899481924644ef09925a5958272678.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99b89734954424903cbbaf0f054f5aced73ecc623568f802b04074fd4582829a.png] 

**Similarly JAMS will be coded as**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4ef7daa15a4447740cae29dbb8b03a8e345697755eebb14883f34a51aaef65b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99b89734954424903cbbaf0f054f5aced73ecc623568f802b04074fd4582829a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
